note: Eval set in the agentskills.io evals/evals.json format. Assertions are checkable, not vibes.

evals.prompt: Triage this repo state and route the top job: main is clean at origin/main; branch i588/remove-profit-take-metrics is fully merged; branch i594/rewards-purge is 21 behind with a focused purge diff; issue #594 is open; one stash holds obsolete plan artifacts.
evals.expected_output: The short report shape from references/report-format.md: a one-line state header, Where/Work/Found lines, one next step with its run line, and a fenced prompt only when that step is a prompt.
assertions: The output opens with the report-format.md header, not prose
Where, Work and Found each render as one line
Exactly one next step is named
The run line names folder, branch, fresh-or-same, and one model
The why line names the task class, the grade, and the quota position
The named model appears in references/models.md on a harness the operator runs
No price table, no routing-system explanation, no list of rejected models
Any fenced prompt names no skill, planner, or earlier chat

evals.prompt: Route a backend refactor with red/green tests (locked plan) plus a subtle PnL-invariant review, using references/models.md and references/capability.md.
evals.expected_output: Model choices by tier with a one-line spend statement, no price tables and no explanation of the routing.
assertions: The chosen models appear in the report's model line, never in a price discussion
No per-token API prices appear; every figure matches references/models.md
The build row is S or better and the invariant review row is AG-2 or AG-6
Each choice names its thinking tier, not only the model
The output states the expected spend in window time or hours

evals.prompt: A build reports: one env failure fixable by unsetting a variable, one absent reference fixture, one skipped local reviewer covered by 'the external review runs anyway'.
evals.expected_output: Classified limitation handling with owners, whens, and operator commands; no silent accepts; no substitute coverage claims.
assertions: Every limitation line in the output carries an owner addressed as 'you' or a named issue plus a when
At least one Class 1 item is fixed in place with a one-line fix note, not reported as failure
At least one Class 2 item carries a paste-ready verify command plus expected output
No external review round is cited as covering a skipped station step
The output ends with branch name plus file paths readable via git show from main
